title: Finding set of "core genes" for Nematoda, Trematoda and Cestoda
protocol: Cluster the full proteomes of twelve nematode species, four trematode species, one cestode and several eukaryotic outgroups using OrthoMCL.
Define NOGs as clusters containing at least one member from each of the twelve included nematode species.
Define TROGs as clusters containing at least one member from each of the four included trematode species.
Build an HMM for each cluster using HMMER v2.3.2.
Cluster the full proteomes of four cestode species and several eukaryotic outgroups using OrthoMCL.
Define CEOGs as groups containing at least one member from each of the four included cestode species.
Build an HMM for each clustering using HMMER v2.3.2.
